title: UI sprite generator: hearts, stars, bubbles, slot silhouettes, cursor, buttons, frames
player_outcome: Hearts, mana stars, breath bubbles, the defence shield, trash can, empty-slot silhouettes, tab icons and the pointer look like crisp, dark-outlined Terraria pixel sprites instead of Godot defaults.
design:
New tools/textures/ui_sprites.py holds ASCII pixel maps with palette letters, split into ui_sprites_b.py so each file stays under 400 lines:
- Vitals: heart (11×11, drawn at 22), heart_gold (palette swap), star (11×11, drawn at 22), bubble (9×9, drawn at 18).
- Inventory: shield (defence), trash; silhouettes slot_head, slot_body, slot_legs, slot_accessory, slot_dye, slot_pet, slot_light_pet, slot_minecart, slot_mount, slot_hook, slot_coin, slot_ammo; favourite_star.
- Buttons: eye_open, eye_closed, sort, quick_stack, deposit, loot, reforge_hammer, toggle_on, toggle_off, tab_equipment, tab_misc.
- Pointer and hints: cursor (Terraria's triangular pointer, white fill with a 2 px dark border, tinted at runtime), smart_cursor, talk_hint (speech bubble), open_hint (hand).
- Frames: minimap_frame as a 24×24 9-slice with 8 px margins.

New tools/textures/build_ui.py.
- Import numpy and Pillow lazily, only when rendering.
- For each map: nearest-neighbour upscale ×2, add a 1 px dark outline (alpha dilation, colour #1a1020), write assets/ui/<name>.png. Output is deterministic (no randomness).
- `--check` needs no Pillow, so CI can run it. It verifies every sprite in the list exists and exits non-zero otherwise.
- `--only=` rebuilds a subset.

New game/UI/UiSprites.cs: a static cache (`Get(string name)`) preloaded when the HUD initialises. It returns a magenta 'missing' texture and logs a warning once when a sprite is absent, like ItemIcons.Missing.
CI: append `python3 tools/textures/build_ui.py --check` to the 'Reference databases and asset coverage' step in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
Run a headless import and commit the PNGs with their .import files. Draw pixel sprites at integral sizes. Controls that only draw these sprites (hearts, stars, bubbles) set `TextureFilter = Nearest`.
files_add: tools/textures/ui_sprites.py, tools/textures/ui_sprites_b.py — pixel maps and palette
tests: AssetCoverageTests.UiSpritesUsedByCodeExist: checks the names referenced by game code (heart, heart_gold, star, bubble, shield, trash, cursor, slot_*, eye_*, sort, quick_stack) exist under assets/ui
verification: Open assets/ui/heart.png, star.png and cursor.png at 400 % in an image viewer: clean outline, no anti-alias fringe
risks: Hand-authored pixel art quality: keep one shared palette and outline colour across files.
CI runners lack Pillow, so --check must never import it.
